🔵 [kimielf-early-return-tail] CUT/FOLLOW-UP `resolve_runner_inputs` now does `return 0` for the ELF layout; the rest of that function is not in the diff, so I could not confirm that no kimi-common step after the node-dir block (e.g. a `--cred-dir` default) is skipped. Excluded because no failure is demonstrable from the diff and it would fail closed; smallest hardening is an if/else around the node-dir block instead of the early return, or one ELF launch case without `--cred-dir`.

Excluded because the spec declares fixture-ELF-only testing on this host and the guard placement is not visible in the diff; smallest hardening is to skip the ELF block when `command -v bwrap` is empty.
🔵 [fcount-deletion-and-pin-only-drift] CUT/FOLLOW-UP The named-member invariants deliberately tolerate an allowlisted path being absent, and no longer track files that set the switch explicitly without a `reviewer_engine:` line (the context-window hermetic roster counted in the old "8"). Excluded because the spec sanctions replacing counts with allowlists plus the pins-the-switch property, and the default-riding risk stays covered: a new unpinned file, a file that drops its pin, and a stale allowlist entry all fail with the path named.
